Armour of Contempt.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the 1CP Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armour of Contempt.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armour of Contempt.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

Focused Fury.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Focused Fury.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Character unit, until the end of the phase, those weapons have the [LANCE] ability as well.

In the Shadow of Great Wings.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
In the Shadow of Great Wings.target: One Adeptus Astartes Character unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
In the Shadow of Great Wings.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

Instant of Grace.target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit from your army.
Instant of Grace.effect: Select one non‑Character model in your unit. Until the start of your next Command phase, your model has the Character keyword. Designer’s Note: While in effect, your model’s unit is therefore a Character unit, meaning it can interact with the Legacy of the Angel Detachment rule, in addition to other rules that interact with Character units.

Strike Now For Glory.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Strike Now For Glory.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.
Strike Now For Glory.lore: Knowing instinctively that the pivotal moment has arrived, these battle‑brothers aim and hammer their foes with unrelenting volleys.

Strike Now for Glory.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Strike Now for Glory.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Unto The Burning Skies.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Unto The Burning Skies.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK** unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, unless it is **THE SANGUINOR**.
Unto The Burning Skies.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
Unto The Burning Skies.lore: In the face of encroaching doom, as the world seems to burn around them, these scions of Sanguinius leap high into the tormented heavens, ready to strike down with vengeful fury upon the enemy teeming below.

Unto the Burning Skies.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Unto the Burning Skies.target: One Adeptus Astartes Jump Pack unit from your army. You cannot target a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, unless it is The Sanguinor.
Unto the Burning Skies.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. As their control slips, so near-animalistic rage takes its place. The foe will not live long enough to regret their error in goading the beast which lurks within every gene-son of Sanguinius. ENHANCEMENTS  CARMINE RELIQUARY This armoured casket contains the skull of a beloved Blood Angels Captain lost to the Black Rage. It is a potent talisman of unfaltering aggression. Chaplain model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Scouts 6" ability. Each time you take a Battle-shock test for an Adeptus Astartes unit within 6" of the bearer, you can re-roll the result.. MASTER OF THE RED THIRST Long practice has allowed this champion to gain a modicum of focus and control over their Red Thirst – wisdom they pass on in the heat of battle. Adeptus Astartes model only. Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer’s unit have the Fights First ability. SANGUINARY TEAR (AURA) Legend has it that the blood-red stone set into this relic houses a teardrop shed by the Primarch himself. Those lost to the Black Rage seem to fight all the more furiously in its presence. Adeptus Astartes model only. While a friendly Death Company unit is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit. ANGEL’S FANG This artificer-crafted weapon has a dark reputation amongst the Chapter. Yet none can deny its lethality, or its machine-spirit’s desire to drink the blood of the mightiest foes. Adeptus Astartes model only. Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a Character, Monster or Vehicle unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

Blinding Blurs of Vengeance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit.
Blinding Blurs of Vengeance.effect: Your unit has Stealth. UNIQUE: DOOMED WRATH OF THE THE DEATH COMPANY BRING THEIR FOES A DOOM THAT IS DETACHMENT RULES FANATICAL CELERITY The madness of the Black Rage burns through the mind of the Lost Brethren with a speed and ferocity matched by the warriors in battle. Swept up in visions of the Primarch’s darkest days of wing‑swift fury, they push their bodies past their limits in efforts to emulate his rapid wrath. ENHANCEMENTS INSTINCTIVE INTERCEPTION Proudly is Sanguinius remembered for his rapid intercession in the protection of his gene‑sons. Driven on by deathly visions, this lost warrior is a tragic monument to such glory. DEATH COMPANY model only. When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is ‑1 CP. ON THE ARCHTRAITOR'S BRIDGE Lost to a memory shard of the Primarch, in this warrior’s mind, he has entered the Archtraitor’s sanctum, and all that stands between him and Horus is a host of massing traitors. DEATH COMPANY model only. This model’s melee attacks have +2 A. DOOMED BLOODY AND SUPERNATURALLY SWIFT

Inexorable Valour.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit that was engaged with a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit ends a fall‑back move, if that SANGUINARY GUARD unit is unengaged.
Inexorable Valour.effect: Your unit can make a normal move of up to D3+3".

Judgement of the Golden Host.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit from your army ends a charge move.
Judgement of the Golden Host.effect: Select one enemy unit engaged with your unit. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit engaged with that enemy unit: ▪ For each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Martial Paragon.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit is selected to attack.
Martial Paragon.effect: Your unit’s attacks have: ▪ [LETHAL HITS]. ▪ OR: [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Soul‑darkened Fury.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit is selected to make a fall‑back move, if that unit is engaged with a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER unit.
Soul‑darkened Fury.effect: When an enemy unit engaged with your unit is selected to make a fall‑back move, that enemy unit must use the desperate escape mode, with ‑1 to those hazard rolls if that enemy unit is battle‑shocked.

A Grim Warning.target: One Blood Angels unit from your army that was just destroyed while it was within range of one or more objective markers you controlled at the end of the previous phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
A Grim Warning.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

Deathless Duty.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Deathless Duty.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Deathless Duty.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

Insensate Rampage.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Insensate Rampage.target: One Death Company unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Insensate Rampage.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

Limb From Limb.target: One Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that made a Charge move this turn.
Limb From Limb.effect: Select either the Strength or Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit. Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the selected characteristic. You can instead choose for your unit to give in to the Red Thirst; if it does, it becomes Battle‑shocked (but the effects of this Stratagem still apply to it), and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.

Angel’s Sacrifice.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK** unit from your army.
Angel’s Sacrifice.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects its targets, it must select your unit as the target of all of its attacks.
Angel’s Sacrifice.lore: The Blood Angels would gladly put themselves in harm’s way to protect others, just as Sanguinius sacrificed his own life.

Armour of Contempt.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Armour of Contempt.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Armour of Contempt.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Armour of Contempt.lore: The belligerence of the Adeptus Astartes combined with their enhanced physiology makes them unyielding foes to face.

Death From The Skies.when: Your Movement phase, just after an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK** unit from your army Advances or Falls Back.
Death From The Skies.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.
Death From The Skies.lore: The roar of the Blood Angels jump packs is as a funeral dirge to their foes.

Martial Examplars.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK** unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

Martial Examplars.lore: The Blood Angels are mighty warriors indeed, and wield their gilded and shimmering blades with consummate skill.

Unbridled Ardour.target: One **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Unbridled Ardour.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly **SANGUINARY GUARD** unit makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your unit, you can re‐roll the Hit roll and you can re‐roll the Wound roll.
Unbridled Ardour.lore: The Sanguinary Guard exemplify the noble heritage of Sanguinius, leaping to avenge their battle‐brothers without hesitation.

Glorious Sacrifice.lore: Even in death, the Lost bring victory to their Chapter.
